answer: Random beacon spot-checks keep the network's pulse honest. Each epoch a beacon picks random agents and demands a compute heartbeat in 30 seconds, a quill-signed receipt no copy can reuse. Miss three checks and the agent loses its oasis: its bond is slashed, its seat revoked. Faking 1,000 identities means 1,000 heartbeats; at 40 units each, that costs 40,000 for a 50-unit reward. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and keeps its full share.
